pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Barrage, growing with the tier, up to +6.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)4 of TNT$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)TNT$(li)Dispenser$(li)Block of Redstone$(li)Piston or Sticky Piston$(li)Observer$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#seating)any seating$(/l)$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#bookshelves)any bookshelves$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Ordnance forms one cluster, and battery is within 4 of ordnance, and charge is within 3 of battery.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Ordnance: TNT$(li)Battery: Dispenser$(li)Charge: Block of Redstone
